verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י אַֽחֲרֵיכֵ֡ן בָּ֣אוּ בְנֵי־ מוֹאָב֩ וּבְנֵ֨י עַמּ֜וֹן וְעִמָּהֶ֧ם׀ מֵֽהָעַמּוֹנִ֛ים עַל־ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’a·ḥă·rê·ḵên bā·’ū ḇə·nê- mō·w·’āḇ ū·ḇə·nê ‘am·mō·wn wə·‘im·mā·hem mê·hā·‘am·mō·w·nîm ‘al- yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ lam·mil·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: After this the Moabites . . . and Ammonites . . . together with some of the Meunites came to make war against Jehoshaphat
verses.literalPt: Depois disso, os filhos de Moabe e os filhos de Amom, com alguns dos amonitas, vieram contra Josafá para lhe fazerem guerra.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֗אוּ וַיַּגִּ֤ידוּ לִֽיהוֹשָׁפָט֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר בָּ֣א עָלֶ֜יךָ הָמ֥וֹן רָ֛ב מֵעֵ֥בֶר לַיָּ֖ם מֵאֲרָ֑ם וְהִנָּם֙ בְּחַֽצְצ֣וֹן תָּמָ֔ר הִ֖יא עֵ֥ין גֶּֽדִי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū way·yag·gî·ḏū lî·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ lê·mōr bā ‘ā·le·ḵā hā·mō·wn rāḇ mê·‘ê·ḇer lay·yām mê·’ă·rām wə·hin·nām bə·ḥaṣ·ṣō·wn tā·mār hî ‘ên ge·ḏî
verses.literal: Then some men came and told Jehoshaphat . . . A vast army is coming against you from Edom from beyond the Sea they are already in Hazazon-tamar (that is En-gedi . . .
verses.literalPt: Então, vieram alguns que avisaram a Josafá, dizendo: Uma grande multidão vem contra ti dalém do mar, da Síria; eis que já estão em Hazazom-Tamor, que é En-Gedi.

verses.original: וַיִּרָ֕א וַיִּתֵּ֧ן יְהוֹשָׁפָ֛ט אֶת־ פָּנָ֖יו לִדְר֣וֹשׁ לַיהוָ֑ה וַיִּקְרָא־ צ֖וֹם עַל־ כָּל־ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·rā way·yit·tên yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ ’eṯ- pā·nāw liḏ·rō·wōš Yah·weh way·yiq·rā- ṣō·wm ‘al- kāl- yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: Jehoshaphat was alarmed and set his face to seek the LORD And he proclaimed a fast throughout . . . Judah
verses.literalPt: Josafá teve medo, e pôs-se a buscar a Jeová, e fez publicar um jejum em todo o Judá.

verses.original: וַיִּקָּבְצ֣וּ יְהוּדָ֔ה לְבַקֵּ֖שׁ מֵֽיְהוָ֑ה גַּ֚ם מִכָּל־ עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה בָּ֖אוּ לְבַקֵּ֥שׁ אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qā·ḇə·ṣū yə·hū·ḏāh lə·ḇaq·qêš Yah·weh gam mik·kāl ‘ā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh bā·’ū lə·ḇaq·qêš ’eṯ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: So the people of Judah gathered to seek the LORD and indeed they came from all the cities of Judah to seek Him
verses.literalPt: Judá ajuntou-se para pedir socorro a Jeová; de todas as cidades de Judá vieram a buscar a Jeová.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲמֹ֣ד יְהוֹשָׁפָ֗ט בִּקְהַ֧ל יְהוּדָ֛ה וִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה לִפְנֵ֖י הֶחָצֵ֥ר הַחֲדָשָֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·mōḏ yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ biq·hal yə·hū·ḏāh wî·rū·šā·lim bə·ḇêṯ Yah·weh lip̄·nê he·ḥā·ṣêr ha·ḥă·ḏā·šāh
verses.literal: Then Jehoshaphat stood in the assembly of Judah and Jerusalem in the house of the LORD in front of the new courtyard
verses.literalPt: Josafá pôs-se em pé diante da congregação de Judá e de Jerusalém, na Casa de Jeová, diante do átrio novo,

verses.original: וַיֹּאמַ֗ר יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י אֲבֹתֵ֙ינוּ֙ הֲלֹ֨א אַתָּֽה־ ה֤וּא אֱלֹהִים֙ בַּשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְאַתָּ֣ה מוֹשֵׁ֔ל בְּכֹ֖ל מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הַגּוֹיִ֑ם וּבְיָדְךָ֙ כֹּ֣חַ וּגְבוּרָ֔ה וְאֵ֥ין עִמְּךָ֖ לְהִתְיַצֵּֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·nū hă·lō ’at·tāh- hū ’ĕ·lō·hîm baš·šā·ma·yim wə·’at·tāh mō·wō·šêl bə·ḵōl mam·lə·ḵō·wṯ hag·gō·w·yim ū·ḇə·yā·ḏə·ḵā kō·aḥ ū·ḡə·ḇū·rāh wə·’ên ‘im·mə·ḵā lə·hiṯ·yaṣ·ṣêḇ
verses.literal: and said O LORD God of our fathers are You . . . not the God who is in heaven and do You not rule over all the kingdoms of the nations Power and might are in Your hand and no one can stand against You
verses.literalPt: e disse: Jeová, Deus de nossos pais, não és tu Deus no céu? Não és tu que dominas sobre todos os reinos das nações? E na tua mão está o poder e a força, de modo que ninguém te pode resistir.

verses.original: הֲלֹ֣א׀ אַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ הוֹרַ֙שְׁתָּ֙ אֶת־ יֹשְׁבֵי֙ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את מִלִּפְנֵ֖י עַמְּךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽתִּתְּנָ֗הּ לְזֶ֛רַע אַבְרָהָ֥ם אֹֽהַבְךָ֖ לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō ’at·tāh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū hō·w·raš·tā ’eṯ- yō·šə·ḇê hā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ mil·lip̄·nê ‘am·mə·ḵā yiś·rā·’êl wat·tit·tə·nāh lə·ze·ra‘ ’aḇ·rā·hām ’ō·haḇ·ḵā lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: Our God did You not drive out the inhabitants of this land before Your people Israel and give it forever to the descendants of Abraham Your friend
verses.literalPt: Não desapossaste tu, nosso Deus, os habitantes desta terra de diante do teu povo de Israel e não a deste para sempre à semente de Abraão, teu amigo?

verses.original: וַיֵּשְׁב֖וּ־ בָ֑הּ וַיִּבְנ֨וּ לְךָ֧׀ בָּ֛הּ מִקְדָּ֖שׁ לְשִׁמְךָ֥ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·šə·ḇū- ḇāh way·yiḇ·nū lə·ḵā bāh miq·dāš lə·šim·ḵā lê·mōr
verses.literal: They have lived in the land and have built in it a sanctuary for Your Name saying
verses.literalPt: Habitaram nela e te edificaram um santuário ao teu nome, dizendo:

verses.original: אִם־ תָּב֨וֹא עָלֵ֜ינוּ רָעָ֗ה חֶרֶב֮ שְׁפוֹט֮ וְדֶ֣בֶר וְרָעָב֒ נַֽעַמְדָ֞ה לִפְנֵ֨י הַבַּ֤יִת הַזֶּה֙ וּלְפָנֶ֔יךָ כִּ֥י שִׁמְךָ֖ בַּבַּ֣יִת הַזֶּ֑ה וְנִזְעַ֥ק אֵלֶ֛יךָ מִצָּרָתֵ֖נוּ וְתִשְׁמַ֥ע וְתוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- tā·ḇō·w ‘ā·lê·nū rā·‘āh ḥe·reḇ šə·p̄ō·wṭ wə·ḏe·ḇer wə·rā·‘āḇ na·‘am·ḏāh lip̄·nê hab·ba·yiṯ haz·zeh ū·lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā kî šim·ḵā bab·ba·yiṯ haz·zeh wə·niz·‘aq ’ê·le·ḵā miṣ·ṣā·rā·ṯê·nū wə·ṯiš·ma‘ wə·ṯō·wō·šî·a‘
verses.literal: If disaster comes upon us whether sword or judgment plague or famine we will stand before this temple and before You for Your Name is in this temple We will cry out to You in our distress and You will hear us and save us
verses.literalPt: Se nos sobrevier algum mal, espada, juízo, peste ou fome, nós nos apresentaremos diante desta casa e diante de ti (pois o teu nome está nesta casa) e clamaremos a ti em nossa aflição, e tu nos ouvirás e salvarás.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֡ה הִנֵּה֩ בְנֵֽי־ עַמּ֨וֹן וּמוֹאָ֜ב וְהַר־ שֵׂעִ֗יר אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹֽא־ נָתַ֤תָּה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לָב֣וֹא בָהֶ֔ם בְּבֹאָ֖ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם כִּ֛י סָ֥רוּ מֵעֲלֵיהֶ֖ם וְלֹ֥א הִשְׁמִידֽוּם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh hin·nêh ḇə·nê- ‘am·mō·wn ū·mō·w·’āḇ wə·har- śê·‘îr ’ă·šer lō- nā·ṯat·tāh lə·yiś·rā·’êl lā·ḇō·w ḇā·hem bə·ḇō·’ām mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim kî sā·rū mê·‘ă·lê·hem wə·lō hiš·mî·ḏūm
verses.literal: And now here are the men of Ammon Moab and Mount Seir whom You did not let Israel invade when they came out of the land of Egypt So Israel turned away from them and did not destroy them
verses.literalPt: Agora, eis que os filhos de Amom, de Moabe e do monte Seir, cujas terras não permitiste a Israel invadir, quando saíam da terra do Egito, mas deles se desviaram e não os destruíram;

verses.original: וְהִ֨נֵּה־ הֵ֔ם גֹּמְלִ֖ים עָלֵ֑ינוּ לָבוֹא֙ לְגָ֣רְשֵׁ֔נוּ מִיְּרֻשָּׁתְךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֽוֹרַשְׁתָּֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh- hêm gō·mə·lîm ‘ā·lê·nū lā·ḇō·w lə·ḡā·rə·šê·nū mî·yə·ruš·šā·ṯə·ḵā ’ă·šer hō·w·raš·tā·nū
verses.literal: See how they are repaying us by coming to drive us out of the possession that You gave us as an inheritance
verses.literalPt: eis como nos dão o pago, vindo para nos lançarem fora da tua possessão, que nos deste em herança.

verses.original: אֱלֹהֵ֙ינוּ֙ הֲלֹ֣א תִשְׁפָּט־ בָּ֔ם כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין בָּ֙נוּ֙ כֹּ֔חַ לִ֠פְנֵי הֶהָמ֥וֹן הָרָ֛ב הַזֶּ֖ה הַבָּ֣א עָלֵ֑ינוּ וַאֲנַ֗חְנוּ לֹ֤א נֵדַע֙ מַֽה־ נַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה כִּ֥י עָלֶ֖יךָ עֵינֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū hă·lō ṯiš·pāṭ- bām kî ’ên bā·nū kō·aḥ lip̄·nê he·hā·mō·wn hā·rāḇ haz·zeh hab·bā ‘ā·lê·nū wa·’ă·naḥ·nū lō nê·ḏa‘ mah- na·‘ă·śeh kî ‘ā·le·ḵā ‘ê·nê·nū
verses.literal: Our God will You not judge them For we are powerless before this vast army that comes against us We do not know what to do but our eyes are upon You
verses.literalPt: Não os julgarás, nosso Deus? Porque não temos força para resistirmos a esta grande multidão que vem contra nós, nem sabemos o que havemos de fazer; mas voltamos para ti os nossos olhos.

verses.original: וְכָ֨ל־ יְהוּדָ֔ה עֹמְדִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה גַּם־ טַפָּ֖ם נְשֵׁיהֶ֥ם וּבְנֵיהֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl- yə·hū·ḏāh ‘ō·mə·ḏîm lip̄·nê Yah·weh gam- ṭap·pām nə·šê·hem ū·ḇə·nê·hem
verses.literal: Meanwhile all the men of Judah with their wives and children and little ones were standing before the LORD
verses.literalPt: Todo o Judá estava em pé, diante de Jeová, com os seus pequeninos, mulheres e filhos.

verses.original: וְיַחֲזִיאֵ֡ל בֶּן־ זְכַרְיָ֡הוּ בֶּן־ בְּ֠נָיָה בֶּן־ יְעִיאֵ֧ל בֶּן־ מַתַּנְיָ֛ה הַלֵּוִ֖י מִן־ בְּנֵ֣י אָסָ֑ף הָיְתָ֤ה עָלָיו֙ ר֣וּחַ יְהוָ֔ה בְּת֖וֹךְ הַקָּהָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ya·ḥă·zî·’êl ben- zə·ḵar·yā·hū ben- bə·nā·yāh ben- yə·‘î·’êl ben- mat·tan·yāh hal·lê·wî min- bə·nê ’ā·sāp̄ hā·yə·ṯāh ‘ā·lāw rū·aḥ Yah·weh bə·ṯō·wḵ haq·qā·hāl
verses.literal: Then the Spirit of the LORD came upon Jahaziel son of Zechariah the son of Benaiah the son of Jeiel the son of Mattaniah a Levite from Asaph’s descendants as he stood in the midst of the assembly
verses.literalPt: Então, no meio da congregação veio o Espírito de Jeová sobre Jaaziel, filho de Zacarias, filho de Benaia, filho de Jeiel, filho de Matanias, levita, dos filhos de Asafe;

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הַקְשִׁ֤יבוּ כָל־ יְהוּדָה֙ וְיֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְהַמֶּ֖לֶךְ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֑ט כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה לָכֶ֗ם אַ֠תֶּם אַל־ תִּֽירְא֤וּ וְאַל־ תֵּחַ֙תּוּ֙ מִפְּנֵ֨י הֶהָמ֤וֹן הָרָב֙ הַזֶּ֔ה כִּ֣י לֹ֥א לָכֶ֛ם הַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה כִּ֥י לֵאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer haq·šî·ḇū ḵāl yə·hū·ḏāh wə·yō·šə·ḇê yə·rū·šā·lim wə·ham·me·leḵ yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh lā·ḵem ’at·tem ’al- tî·rə·’ū wə·’al- tê·ḥat·tū mip·pə·nê he·hā·mō·wn hā·rāḇ haz·zeh kî lō lā·ḵem ham·mil·ḥā·māh kî lê·lō·hîm
verses.literal: And he said Listen all you people of Judah and Jerusalem Listen, King Jehoshaphat This is what the LORD says Do not be afraid . . . or discouraged because of this vast army for the battle does not belong to you but to God
verses.literalPt: e disse: Ouvi todos vós, povo de Judá, e vós os que habitais em Jerusalém, e tu, ó rei Josafá; assim vos diz Jeová: Não tenhais medo, nem vos assusteis por causa desta grande multidão, pois não é vossa a peleja, mas sim de Deus.

verses.original: מָחָר֙ רְד֣וּ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם הִנָּ֥ם עֹלִ֖ים בְּמַעֲלֵ֣ה הַצִּ֑יץ וּמְצָאתֶ֤ם אֹתָם֙ בְּס֣וֹף הַנַּ֔חַל פְּנֵ֖י מִדְבַּ֥ר יְרוּאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: mā·ḥār rə·ḏū ‘ă·lê·hem hin·nām ‘ō·lîm bə·ma·‘ă·lêh haṣ·ṣîṣ ū·mə·ṣā·ṯem ’ō·ṯām bə·sō·wp̄ han·na·ḥal pə·nê miḏ·bar yə·rū·’êl
verses.literal: Tomorrow you are to march down against them You will see them coming up the Ascent of Ziz and you will find them at the end of the valley facing the Wilderness of Jeruel
verses.literalPt: Amanhã, descereis contra eles. Eis que sobem pela subida de Ziz; achá-los-eis na extremidade do vale, defronte do deserto de Jeruel.

verses.original: לֹ֥א לָכֶ֖ם לְהִלָּחֵ֣ם בָּזֹ֑את הִתְיַצְּב֣וּ עִמְד֡וּ וּרְא֣וּ אֶת־ יְשׁוּעַת֩ יְהוָ֨ה עִמָּכֶ֜ם יְהוּדָ֣ה וִֽירוּשָׁלִַ֗ם אַל־ תִּֽירְאוּ֙ וְאַל־ תֵּחַ֔תּוּ מָחָר֙ צְא֣וּ לִפְנֵיהֶ֔ם וַיהוָ֖ה עִמָּכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lō lā·ḵem lə·hil·lā·ḥêm bā·zōṯ hiṯ·yaṣ·ṣə·ḇū ‘im·ḏū ū·rə·’ū ’eṯ- yə·šū·‘aṯ Yah·weh ‘im·mā·ḵem yə·hū·ḏāh wî·rū·šā·lim ’al- tî·rə·’ū wə·’al- tê·ḥat·tū mā·ḥār ṣə·’ū lip̄·nê·hem Yah·weh ‘im·mā·ḵem
verses.literal: You need not fight this battle Take up your positions stand firm and see the salvation of the LORD on your behalf O Judah and Jerusalem Do not be afraid . . . or discouraged Go out and face them tomorrow for the LORD is with you
verses.literalPt: Nesta batalha, não tereis que pelejar; postai-vos, ficai parados e vede a salvação que Jeová vos dará, ó Judá e Jerusalém. Não tenhais medo, nem vos assusteis; amanhã saí-lhes ao encontro, pois Jeová está convosco.

verses.original: וַיִּקֹּ֧ד יְהוֹשָׁפָ֛ט אַפַּ֖יִם אָ֑רְצָה וְכָל־ יְהוּדָ֞ה וְיֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם נָֽפְלוּ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֖ת לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qōḏ yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ ’ap·pa·yim ’ā·rə·ṣāh wə·ḵāl yə·hū·ḏāh wə·yō·šə·ḇê yə·rū·šā·lim nā·p̄ə·lū lip̄·nê Yah·weh lə·hiš·ta·ḥă·wōṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Then Jehoshaphat bowed facedown . . . and all the people of Judah and Jerusalem fell down before the LORD to worship Him
verses.literalPt: Josafá prostrou-se com o rosto em terra; e todo o Judá e os moradores de Jerusalém prostraram-se diante de Jeová, adorando-o.

verses.original: וַיָּקֻ֧מוּ הַלְוִיִּ֛ם מִן־ בְּנֵ֥י הַקְּהָתִ֖ים וּמִן־ בְּנֵ֣י הַקָּרְחִ֑ים לְהַלֵּ֗ל לַיהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּק֥וֹל גָּד֖וֹל לְמָֽעְלָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qu·mū hal·wî·yim min- bə·nê haq·qə·hā·ṯîm ū·min- bə·nê haq·qā·rə·ḥîm lə·hal·lêl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl bə·qō·wl gā·ḏō·wl lə·mā·‘ə·lāh
verses.literal: And the Levites from the Kohathites . . . . . . and Korahites stood up to praise the LORD the God of Israel shouting in a very loud . . . voice
verses.literalPt: Os levitas dos filhos dos coatitas e dos filhos dos coreítas levantaram-se para louvarem a Jeová, Deus de Israel, em voz bem alta.

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁכִּ֣ימוּ בַבֹּ֔קֶר וַיֵּצְא֖וּ לְמִדְבַּ֣ר תְּק֑וֹעַ וּבְצֵאתָ֞ם עָמַ֣ד יְהוֹשָׁפָ֗ט וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ שְׁמָע֗וּנִי יְהוּדָה֙ וְיֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם הַאֲמִ֜ינוּ בַּיהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם֙ וְתֵ֣אָמֵ֔נוּ הַאֲמִ֥ינוּ בִנְבִיאָ֖יו וְהַצְלִֽיחוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaš·kî·mū ḇab·bō·qer way·yê·ṣə·’ū lə·miḏ·bar tə·qō·w·a‘ ū·ḇə·ṣê·ṯām ‘ā·maḏ yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ way·yō·mer šə·mā·‘ū·nî yə·hū·ḏāh wə·yō·šə·ḇê yə·rū·šā·lim ha·’ă·mî·nū Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem wə·ṯê·’ā·mê·nū ha·’ă·mî·nū ḇin·ḇî·’āw wə·haṣ·lî·ḥū
verses.literal: Early in the morning they got up and left for the Wilderness of Tekoa As they set out Jehoshaphat stood up and said Hear me O people of Judah and Jerusalem Believe in the LORD your God and you will be upheld believe in His prophets and you will succeed
verses.literalPt: Levantando-se cedo de manhã, saíram para o deserto de Tecoa. Ao saírem eles, pôs-se em pé Josafá e disse: Ouvi-me, Judá e vós os que habitais em Jerusalém. Crede em Jeová, vosso Deus e assim sereis estabelecidos; crede os seus profetas e assim prosperareis.

verses.original: וַיִּוָּעַץ֙ אֶל־ הָעָ֔ם וַיַּעֲמֵ֤ד מְשֹֽׁרֲרִים֙ לַיהוָ֔ה וּֽמְהַֽלְלִ֖ים לְהַדְרַת־ קֹ֑דֶשׁ בְּצֵאת֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הֶֽחָל֔וּץ וְאֹֽמְרִים֙ הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י לְעוֹלָ֖ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiw·wā·‘aṣ ’el- hā·‘ām way·ya·‘ă·mêḏ mə·šō·ră·rîm Yah·weh ū·mə·hal·lîm lə·haḏ·raṯ- qō·ḏeš bə·ṣêṯ lip̄·nê he·ḥā·lūṣ wə·’ō·mə·rîm hō·w·ḏū Yah·weh kî lə·‘ō·w·lām ḥas·dōw
verses.literal: Then Jehoshaphat consulted with the people and appointed those who would sing to the LORD and praise the splendor of His holiness As they went out before the army they were singing Give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion endures forever
verses.literalPt: Tendo ele tomado conselho com o povo, designou os que haviam de cantar a Jeová, e louvar a beleza da santidade, quando saíram diante do exército, e dizer: Dai graças a Jeová, porque a sua misericórdia dura para sempre.

verses.original: וּבְעֵת֩ הֵחֵ֨לּוּ בְרִנָּ֜ה וּתְהִלָּ֗ה נָתַ֣ן יְהוָ֣ה׀ מְ֠אָֽרְבִים עַל־ בְּנֵ֨י עַמּ֜וֹן מוֹאָ֧ב וְהַר־ שֵׂעִ֛יר הַבָּאִ֥ים לִֽיהוּדָ֖ה וַיִּנָּגֵֽפוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·‘êṯ hê·ḥêl·lū ḇə·rin·nāh ū·ṯə·hil·lāh nā·ṯan Yah·weh mə·’ā·rə·ḇîm ‘al- bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn mō·w·’āḇ wə·har- śê·‘îr hab·bā·’îm lî·hū·ḏāh way·yin·nā·ḡê·p̄ū
verses.literal: The moment they began their shouts and praises the LORD set ambushes against the men of Ammon . . . Moab and Mount Seir who had come against Judah and they were defeated
verses.literalPt: Quando começaram a cantar e a dar louvores, pôs Jeová emboscadas contra os filhos de Amom, de Moabe e do monte Seir, que tinham vindo contra Judá; e foram desbaratados.

verses.original: וַ֠יַּֽעַמְדוּ בְּנֵ֨י עַמּ֧וֹן וּמוֹאָ֛ב עַל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הַר־ שֵׂעִ֖יר לְהַחֲרִ֣ים וּלְהַשְׁמִ֑יד וּכְכַלּוֹתָם֙ בְּיוֹשְׁבֵ֣י שֵׂעִ֔יר עָזְר֥וּ אִישׁ־ בְּרֵעֵ֖הוּ לְמַשְׁחִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘am·ḏū bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn ū·mō·w·’āḇ ‘al- yō·šə·ḇê har- śê·‘îr lə·ha·ḥă·rîm ū·lə·haš·mîḏ ū·ḵə·ḵal·lō·w·ṯām bə·yō·wō·šə·ḇê śê·‘îr ‘ā·zə·rū ’îš- bə·rê·‘ê·hū lə·maš·ḥîṯ
verses.literal: The Ammonites . . . and Moabites rose up against the inhabitants of Mount Seir devoting them to destruction And when they had finished off the inhabitants of Seir they helped to destroy one another
verses.literalPt: Porque os filhos de Amom e de Moabe se levantaram contra os habitantes do monte Seir, para os matar e destruir por completo; e, tendo acabado com os habitantes do monte Seir, feriram-se uns aos outros.

verses.original: וִֽיהוּדָ֛ה בָּ֥א עַל־ הַמִּצְפֶּ֖ה לַמִּדְבָּ֑ר וַיִּפְנוּ֙ אֶל־ הֶ֣הָמ֔וֹן וְהִנָּ֧ם פְּגָרִ֛ים נֹפְלִ֥ים אַ֖רְצָה וְאֵ֥ין פְּלֵיטָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wî·hū·ḏāh bā ‘al- ham·miṣ·peh lam·miḏ·bār way·yip̄·nū ’el- he·hā·mō·wn wə·hin·nām pə·ḡā·rîm nō·p̄ə·lîm ’ar·ṣāh wə·’ên pə·lê·ṭāh
verses.literal: When the men of Judah came to a place overlooking the wilderness they looked for the vast army but there were only corpses lying on the ground no one had escaped
verses.literalPt: Tendo Judá chegado à atalaia do deserto, olharam para a multidão. Eis que tudo eram corpos mortos jazendo em terra, e não houve ninguém que escapasse.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֨א יְהוֹשָׁפָ֣ט וְעַמּוֹ֮ לָבֹ֣ז אֶת־ שְׁלָלָם֒ וַיִּמְצְאוּ֩ בָהֶ֨ם לָרֹ֜ב וּרְכ֤וּשׁ וּפְגָרִים֙ וּכְלֵ֣י חֲמֻד֔וֹת וַיְנַצְּל֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם לְאֵ֣ין מַשָּׂ֑א וַיִּֽהְי֞וּ יָמִ֧ים שְׁלוֹשָׁ֛ה בֹּזְזִ֥ים אֶת־ הַשָּׁלָ֖ל כִּ֥י רַב־ הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ wə·‘am·mōw lā·ḇōz ’eṯ- šə·lā·lām way·yim·ṣə·’ū ḇā·hem lā·rōḇ ū·rə·ḵūš ū·p̄ə·ḡā·rîm ū·ḵə·lê ḥă·mu·ḏō·wṯ way·naṣ·ṣə·lū lā·hem lə·’ên maś·śā way·yih·yū yā·mîm šə·lō·wō·šāh bō·zə·zîm ’eṯ- haš·šā·lāl kî raḇ- hū
verses.literal: Then Jehoshaphat and his people went to carry off the plunder and they found on the bodies an abundance of goods and valuables . . . more than they could carry away They were gathering the plunder for three days because there was so much . . .
verses.literalPt: Quando Josafá e seu povo vieram para tirar os despojos deles, acharam entre eles fazenda, e cadáveres em abundância, e joias preciosas que tomaram para si, mais do que podiam levar; e gastaram três dias em saquearem o despojo, tão grande era.

verses.original: וּבַיּ֣וֹם הָרְבִעִ֗י נִקְהֲלוּ֙ לְעֵ֣מֶק בְּרָכָ֔ה כִּי־ שָׁ֖ם בֵּרֲכ֣וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה עַל־ כֵּ֡ן קָֽרְא֞וּ אֶת־ שֵׁ֨ם הַמָּק֥וֹם הַה֛וּא עֵ֥מֶק בְּרָכָ֖ה עַד־ הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇay·yō·wm hā·rə·ḇi·‘î niq·hă·lū lə·‘ê·meq bə·rā·ḵāh kî- šām bê·ră·ḵū ’eṯ- Yah·weh ‘al- kên qā·rə·’ū ’eṯ- šêm ham·mā·qō·wm ha·hū ‘ê·meq bə·rā·ḵāh ‘aḏ- hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: On the fourth day they assembled in the Valley of Beracah where they blessed the LORD Therefore . . . that place is called - the Valley of Beracah to this day
verses.literalPt: Ao quarto dia, eles se ajuntaram no vale de Beraca, pois ali bendisseram a Jeová. Por isso, aquele lugar ficou sendo chamado o vale de Beraca até o dia de hoje.

verses.original: וַ֠יָּשֻׁבוּ כָּל־ אִ֨ישׁ יְהוּדָ֤ה וִֽירוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ וִֽיהוֹשָׁפָ֣ט בְּרֹאשָׁ֔ם לָשׁ֥וּב אֶל־ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בְּשִׂמְחָ֑ה כִּֽי־ שִׂמְּחָ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה מֵֽאוֹיְבֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šu·ḇū kāl- ’îš yə·hū·ḏāh wî·rū·šā·lim wî·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ bə·rō·šām lā·šūḇ ’el- yə·rū·šā·lim bə·śim·ḥāh kî- śim·mə·ḥām Yah·weh mê·’ō·wy·ḇê·hem
verses.literal: Then all the men of Judah and Jerusalem with Jehoshaphat at their head returned joyfully to Jerusalem for the LORD had made them rejoice over their enemies
verses.literalPt: Então, voltaram para Jerusalém com alegria todos os homens de Judá e de Jerusalém, com Josafá à frente, porque Jeová os tinha feito regozijar-se sobre os seus inimigos.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם בִּנְבָלִ֥ים וּבְכִנֹּר֖וֹת וּבַחֲצֹצְר֑וֹת אֶל־ בֵּ֖ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū yə·rū·šā·lim bin·ḇā·lîm ū·ḇə·ḵin·nō·rō·wṯ ū·ḇa·ḥă·ṣō·ṣə·rō·wṯ ’el- bêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: So they entered Jerusalem and went into the house of the LORD with harps lyres and trumpets
verses.literalPt: Vieram a Jerusalém com alaúdes, harpas e trombetas para a Casa de Jeová.

verses.original: וַיְהִי֙ פַּ֣חַד אֱלֹהִ֔ים עַ֖ל כָּל־ מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָאֲרָצ֑וֹת בְּשָׁמְעָ֕ם כִּ֚י נִלְחַ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה עִ֖ם אוֹיְבֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî pa·ḥaḏ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘al kāl- mam·lə·ḵō·wṯ hā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ bə·šā·mə·‘ām kî nil·ḥam Yah·weh ‘im ’ō·wy·ḇê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: And the fear of God came upon all the kingdoms of the lands when they heard that the LORD had fought against the enemies of Israel
verses.literalPt: O terror da parte de Deus veio sobre todos os reinos dos países, quando ouviram que Jeová tinha pelejado contra os inimigos de Israel.

verses.original: וַתִּשְׁקֹ֖ט מַלְכ֣וּת יְהוֹשָׁפָ֑ט וַיָּ֧נַֽח ל֦וֹ אֱלֹהָ֖יו מִסָּבִֽיב׃פ
verses.transliteration: wat·tiš·qōṭ mal·ḵūṯ yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ way·yā·naḥ lōw ’ĕ·lō·hāw mis·sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: Then Jehoshaphat’s kingdom was at peace for his God had given him rest on every side
verses.literalPt: Assim, o reino de Josafá ficou em paz, porque o seu Deus lhe deu repouso ao redor.

verses.original: וַיִּמְלֹ֥ךְ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט עַל־ יְהוּדָ֑ה בֶּן־ שְׁלֹשִׁים֩ וְחָמֵ֨שׁ שָׁנָ֜ה בְּמָלְכ֗וֹ וְעֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְחָמֵ֤שׁ שָׁנָה֙ מָלַ֣ךְ בִּֽירוּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ עֲזוּבָ֖ה בַּת־ שִׁלְחִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yim·lōḵ yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ ‘al- yə·hū·ḏāh ben- šə·lō·šîm wə·ḥā·mêš šā·nāh bə·mā·lə·ḵōw wə·‘eś·rîm wə·ḥā·mêš šā·nāh mā·laḵ bî·rū·šā·lim wə·šêm ’im·mōw ‘ă·zū·ḇāh baṯ- šil·ḥî
verses.literal: So Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah He was thirty-five . . . years old . . . when he became king and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-five . . . years His mother’s name was Azubah daughter of Shilhi
verses.literalPt: Josafá reinou sobre Judá. Ele tinha trinta e cinco anos quando começou a reinar e reinou vinte e cinco anos em Jerusalém. Sua mãe chamava-se Azuba, filha de Sili.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֗לֶךְ בְּדֶ֛רֶךְ אָבִ֥יו אָסָ֖א וְלֹא־ סָ֣ר מִמֶּ֑נָּה לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת הַיָּשָׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ bə·ḏe·reḵ ’ā·ḇîw ’ā·sā wə·lō- sār mim·men·nāh la·‘ă·śō·wṯ hay·yā·šār bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: And Jehoshaphat walked in the way of his father Asa and did not turn away from it he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Ele andou nos caminhos de seu pai Asa, e deles não se afastou, fazendo o que era reto aos olhos de Jeová.

verses.original: אַ֥ךְ הַבָּמ֖וֹת לֹא־ סָ֑רוּ וְע֤וֹד הָעָם֙ לֹא־ הֵכִ֣ינוּ לְבָבָ֔ם לֵאלֹהֵ֖י אֲבֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ hab·bā·mō·wṯ lō- sā·rū wə·‘ō·wḏ hā·‘ām lō- hê·ḵî·nū lə·ḇā·ḇām lê·lō·hê ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·hem
verses.literal: The high places however were not removed the people had not yet set their hearts on the God of their fathers
verses.literalPt: Contudo, os altos não se tiraram; nem tinha ainda o povo disposto o seu coração para o Deus de seus pais.

verses.original: וְיֶ֙תֶר֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י יְהוֹשָׁפָ֔ט הָרִאשֹׁנִ֖ים וְהָאַחֲרֹנִ֑ים הִנָּ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים בְּדִבְרֵי֙ יֵה֣וּא בֶן־ חֲנָ֔נִי אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֹֽעֲלָ֔ה עַל־ סֵ֖פֶר מַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ hā·ri·šō·nîm wə·hā·’a·ḥă·rō·nîm hin·nām kə·ṯū·ḇîm bə·ḏiḇ·rê yê·hū ḇen- ḥă·nā·nî ’ă·šer hō·‘ă·lāh ‘al- sê·p̄er mal·ḵê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat from beginning to end they are indeed written in the Chronicles of Jehu son of Hanani which are recorded in the Book of the Kings of Israel
verses.literalPt: Ora, o restante dos atos de Josafá, tanto os primeiros como os últimos, eis que estão escritos na História de Jeú, filho de Hanani, que está inserta no Livro dos Reis de Israel.

verses.original: וְאַחֲרֵיכֵ֗ן אֶתְחַבַּר֙ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֣ט מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֔ה עִ֖ם אֲחַזְיָ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל ה֖וּא הִרְשִׁ֥יעַ לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’a·ḥă·rê·ḵên ’eṯ·ḥab·bar yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh ‘im ’ă·ḥaz·yāh me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl hū hir·šî·a‘ la·‘ă·śō·wṯ
verses.literal: Later Jehoshaphat king of Judah made an alliance with Ahaziah king of Israel who acted wickedly
verses.literalPt: Depois disso, aliou-se Josafá, rei de Judá, com Acazias, rei de Israel, que procedeu mui iniquamente.

verses.original: וַיְחַבְּרֵ֣הוּ עִמּ֔וֹ לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת אֳנִיּ֖וֹת לָלֶ֣כֶת תַּרְשִׁ֑ישׁ וַיַּעֲשׂ֥וּ אֳנִיּ֖וֹת בְּעֶצְי֥וֹן גָּֽבֶר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḥab·bə·rê·hū ‘im·mōw la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’o·nî·yō·wṯ lā·le·ḵeṯ tar·šîš way·ya·‘ă·śū ’o·nî·yō·wṯ bə·‘eṣ·yō·wn gā·ḇer
verses.literal: They agreed . . . to make ships to go to Tarshish and these were built . . . in Ezion-geber
verses.literalPt: Aliou-se com ele para construírem navios que fossem a Társis; e construíram os navios em Eziom-Geber.

verses.original: וַיִּתְנַבֵּ֞א אֱלִיעֶ֤זֶר בֶּן־ דֹּדָוָ֙הוּ֙ מִמָּ֣רֵשָׁ֔ה עַל־ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט לֵאמֹ֑ר כְּהִֽתְחַבֶּרְךָ֣ עִם־ אֲחַזְיָ֗הוּ פָּרַ֤ץ יְהוָה֙ אֶֽת־ מַעֲשֶׂ֔יךָ וַיִּשָּׁבְר֣וּ אֳנִיּ֔וֹת וְלֹ֥א עָצְר֖וּ לָלֶ֥כֶת אֶל־ תַּרְשִֽׁישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·nab·bê ’ĕ·lî·‘e·zer ben- dō·ḏā·wā·hū mim·mā·rê·šāh ‘al- yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ lê·mōr kə·hiṯ·ḥab·ber·ḵā ‘im- ’ă·ḥaz·yā·hū pā·raṣ Yah·weh ’eṯ- ma·‘ă·śe·ḵā way·yiš·šā·ḇə·rū ’o·nî·yō·wṯ wə·lō ‘ā·ṣə·rū lā·le·ḵeṯ ’el- tar·šîš
verses.literal: Then Eliezer son of Dodavahu of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat saying Because you have allied yourself with Ahaziah the LORD has destroyed your works So the ships were wrecked and were unable to sail to Tarshish
verses.literalPt: Então, Eliézer, filho de Dodava, de Maresa, profetizou contra Josafá, dizendo: Pois que te aliaste com Acazias, destruiu Jeová as tuas obras. Os navios despedaçaram-se e não puderam ir a Társis.
